i *may* have a question that I'm pretty sure of the answer to, but just to make sure here, cause it was such a weird circumstance of events.

so we had Haka, Crono Ranger, and Nightmist fighting La Capitan in the Time Cataclysm. first several rounds went as per the usual, shenangians ensued, and long story short we were in a tough spot with Crono-Ranger at 3 HP left with an armory in front of him, Haka with his Club of Smashiness and Stick of Beatings(I forget what they're actually called, but it's the only equipment he has[and yes, this is important to the question]) and Savage Mana, with Nightmist having her nice compliment of amazing healing every round. La Capitan had a nice array of her grunt people out, who were all nicely damaged and primed for being sucked under Savage Mana, but i couldn't get at all of them without a Rampage, which of course would kill off Chrono Ranger. as a group, we had all decided it was the best option, since he was going to get knocked out regardless of what any of us did. As Haka, i was the last player to go, so this was a massive decision.

My question is this: since RAMPAGE knocked out Chrono-Ranger, thereby "destroying" him, would he get pulled into Savage Mana as well as any others that got destroyed by that same card?

posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked: No, because he isn't destroyed. When a hero character card would be destroyed, you flip that card instead. Savage Mana specificaly acts on being destroyed. If a hero were to be killed by by the environment with Savage Wasteland out, they would be removed from the game as that has the text "would be destroyed" rather than "When Haka destroys a target".
